nodes.name: Victrex
nodes.description: Public London-listed PEEK polymer maker (VICTREX PEEK / PAEK, HPG gears); one of ~4 thousand-ton-scale PEEK producers worldwide. Markets PEEK for robotics gears, bushings/bearings, and lightweight components replacing metal. PEEK is the headline lightweighting polymer in humanoid skeletons/limbs.

nodes.name: Evonik
nodes.description: Public Frankfurt-listed specialty-chemicals maker; VESTAKEEP PEEK line (incl. tribological Easy Slide 2 slide bearings) explicitly marketed to the robotics industry. One of ~4 thousand-ton-scale PEEK producers worldwide.

nodes.name: Zhejiang Sanhua Intelligent Controls
nodes.description: Public Shenzhen-listed automotive/HVAC thermal-management maker (microchannel liquid cooling, electronic expansion valves) widely reported as a Tesla Optimus thermal / liquid-cooling and actuator supplier. CAUTION: a quality source states Sanhua's current humanoid focus is electromechanical actuators, not thermal systems — the 'exclusive Optimus liquid-cooling supplier' claims trace to SEO/substack and are NOT confirmed here. Modeled reported-capable; flag for verifier.

edges.claim: NSK is a public supplier candidate for humanoid joint thin-section/precision bearings, and is vertically integrating bearings into its own humanoid rotary/linear actuators; not a confirmed humanoid BOM claim.

Schaeffler is a public supplier candidate for humanoid joint bearings (XZU four-point bearing variant for the humanoid market; bearing integrated into the actuator rotor); not a confirmed humanoid BOM claim.

RBC Bearings is a public supplier candidate for humanoid joint thin-section bearings; its thin-section line names Robotics, Rotary Joints, Harmonic Drives, and Speed Reducers as typical applications. Not a confirmed humanoid BOM claim.
THK is a reported-capable supplier of cross-roller rings used as rotary bearings for robot joints; modeled reported-capable because no THK primary page could be fetched this round (thk.com 403).
NTN is a reported-capable supplier of crossed-roller bearings for robot reduction gears; modeled reported-capable because the NTN robot pages were unreachable/403 this round.
Victrex is a public PEEK supplier candidate for humanoid structural/lightweighting material (PEEK gears, bushings, limb/skeleton components replacing metal); not a confirmed humanoid BOM claim.

Evonik is a public PEEK supplier candidate for humanoid structural/lightweighting material (VESTAKEEP PEEK, incl. slide bearings, marketed to the robotics industry); not a confirmed humanoid BOM claim.

Syensqo (KetaSpire PEEK) is a reported-capable PEEK supplier for humanoid structural/lightweighting material; modeled reported-capable because syensqo.com PEEK pages returned 406 this round (no fetched robotics quote). One of ~4 thousand-ton-scale PEEK makers.

Sanhua is reported in industry coverage as a Tesla Optimus thermal / liquid-cooling supplier, leveraging its automotive microchannel-liquid-cooling thermal technology. Modeled reported-capable (NOT manufactured_by): a quality source says its current humanoid focus is actuators, not thermal; the liquid-cooling-share claims are unverified SEO/substack. Flag for verifier.

Henkel (Bergquist TIMs) is a reported-capable supplier of thermal interface materials for the humanoid thermal stack; its TIM markets include power/industrial automation. Robotics is not named in the fetched primary body, so modeled reported-capable rather than manufactured_by.

evidence.title: NSK to Exhibit at iREX 2025
evidence.summary: NSK exhibit announcement ties its thin-section ball bearings and newly developed rotary/linear actuators to humanoid robots; supports NSK as a humanoid joint-bearing supplier candidate and the bearing->actuator vertical-integration angle.
evidence.excerpt: NSK will exhibit various cutting-edge components, including newly developed rotary/linear actuators applicable to humanoid robots, the NSK line-up of thin-section ball bearings contributing to higher performance and smaller/lighter designs of robots
evidence.limitations: Vendor exhibit announcement; shows applicability/intent for humanoid robots, not a confirmed humanoid OEM win, share, or capacity. Ticker not on this page (NSK = 6471.T, established cross-domain org_nsk).

evidence.title: NSK Signs MOU with Delta Electronics for Collaboration in Robotics
evidence.summary: NSK-Delta MOU describes NSK contributing bearings, ball screws, and linear-motion expertise into rotary and linear actuators (robot joints), evidencing NSK moving from bearing supplier toward integrated humanoid/collaborative-robot actuators.
evidence.excerpt: NSK has built a strong track record in industrial robotics, focusing on bearings and linear motion products
evidence.limitations: MOU/partnership announcement; the fetched text frames bearings/linear-motion in industrial robotics broadly and rotary/linear actuators (joints) for robots, not a humanoid-specific BOM or share. Supports the bearing->actuator vertical-integration angle qualitatively.

evidence.title: Schaeffler wins Hermes Award for innovative actuator platform (humanoid robotics)
evidence.summary: Schaeffler's humanoid actuator platform integrates the bearing into the rotor; release confirms Schaeffler bearing/precision-drive content designed for humanoid robot joints and the SHA ticker context.
evidence.excerpt: Thanks to an innovative architecture where the bearing is integrated into the rotor, the installation footprint is reduced by around 20 percent and the weight by up to 500 grams.
evidence.limitations: Secondary host (webdisclosure) carrying the Schaeffler release; schaeffler.com primary returned 403 this round. The 20% / 500 g figures describe the actuator platform design, not a market share. Confirms Schaeffler bearing-in-rotor content for humanoid joints. Schaeffler = SHA.DE (cross-domain org_schaeffler).

evidence.title: Humanoid Secures Landmark Deal with Schaeffler to Deploy Thousands of Humanoid Robots
evidence.summary: Schaeffler named preferred actuator supplier covering >50% of UK maker Humanoid's joint-actuator demand through 2031; quantifies a strategic-supply concentration in the actuator/bearing tier. (Same episode as dev-set humanoid_schaeffler_actuator_strategic_supply_2026.)
evidence.excerpt: Schaeffler will become Humanoid's preferred supplier, covering more than 50% of the company's demand for joint actuators for its wheeled-based platforms through 2031.
evidence.limitations: Strategic-supply share for ONE OEM (Humanoid), not Schaeffler's bearing market share. Trade-press source carrying the companies' announcement.

evidence.title: Thin Section Ball Bearings | RBC Bearings Incorporated
evidence.summary: RBC thin-section ball-bearing page lists Robotics, Rotary Joints, Harmonic Drives, and Speed Reducers among typical applications; supports RBC as a humanoid joint thin-section bearing supplier candidate.
evidence.excerpt: Thin section ball bearings are generally used in applications with space, weight, and load constraints. ... Rotary Joints ... Robotics ... Harmonic Drives ... Speed Reducers
evidence.limitations: Vendor product page; names robotics/rotary-joints/harmonic-drive/speed-reducer applications generally, not a humanoid-specific OEM win or share. Application list reproduced verbatim from the page's Typical Applications section. RBC = RBC (NYSE, cross-domain org_rbc_bearings).

evidence.title: THK Co., Ltd. (6481.T) listing / securities code
evidence.summary: Confirms THK Co., Ltd. trades as 6481 on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (6481.T). THK is an established cross-roller-ring maker for robot joints; primary THK product pages could not be fetched this round (403), so the robot-bearing capability is modeled reported-capable.
evidence.limitations: Ticker/listing confirmation only. No fetched THK primary page asserts the humanoid/robot bearing application this round (thk.com 403). Capability modeled as reported_capable_supplier pending a primary quote. THK = cross-domain org_thk.

evidence.title: NTN Corporation (6472.T) listing / securities code
evidence.summary: Confirms NTN Corporation trades as 6472 on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (6472.T). NTN runs a dedicated robotics bearing line (crossed-roller bearings for robot reduction gears); its robot pages were unreachable this round, so the capability is modeled reported-capable.
evidence.excerpt: NTN CORPORATION ... 6472 on the Tokyo Stock Exchange
evidence.limitations: Ticker/listing confirmation only. NTN robot product pages (ntnglobal.com, ntn-snr.com) were 403/unreachable this round; humanoid/robot bearing capability modeled as reported_capable_supplier pending a primary quote. NTN = cross-domain org_ntn.

evidence.title: Robotics and Automation | Electroactive Polymers for Robotic Applications - Victrex
evidence.summary: Victrex robotics page markets VICTREX PEEK as a lighter-than-metal alternative for collaborative-robot gearboxes and components; supports Victrex as a humanoid structural/lightweighting PEEK supplier candidate.
evidence.excerpt: Quieter and up to 25% lighter than metal, VICTREX PEEK solutions enable efficiencies for collaborative applications.
evidence.limitations: Vendor industry page; the 25%-lighter figure is a material property vs metal, not a market share. Frames robotics/cobot use, not a confirmed humanoid OEM win or PEEK market share. Companion quote on same page: 'VICTREX PEEK & thermoplastic hybrid gears offer an alternative to metal planetary system gearboxes.'

evidence.title: Victrex plc (VCT.L) listing
evidence.summary: Confirms Victrex plc is listed on the London Stock Exchange under ticker VCT (VCT.L).
evidence.limitations: Ticker/listing confirmation only; no humanoid-specific claim.

evidence.title: Evonik launches new tribological PEEK material for use in high temperature and pressure slide bearing applications
evidence.summary: Evonik press release names the robotics industry among customers for its VESTAKEEP PEEK (incl. new tribological Easy Slide 2 slide-bearing grade); supports Evonik as a humanoid structural/tribological PEEK supplier candidate.
evidence.excerpt: This includes working with customers in the industrial, medical and robotics industry to solve their especially challenging needs,
evidence.limitations: Vendor press release; names robotics as a customer industry for VESTAKEEP PEEK generally, not a confirmed humanoid OEM win or PEEK market share. No number claimed. Evonik = EVK.DE.

evidence.title: Syensqo successfully launched on Euronext (SYENS)
evidence.summary: Confirms Syensqo (2023 spin-off of Solvay specialty polymers) is publicly listed on Euronext Brussels/Paris under ticker SYENS. Syensqo's KetaSpire PEEK is one of ~4 thousand-ton-scale PEEK lines; modeled reported-capable for humanoid lightweighting because syensqo.com PEEK pages returned 406 this round.
evidence.limitations: Listing/ticker context via search snippet (syensqo.com product pages 406 this round). No fetched robotics-application quote; humanoid PEEK capability modeled as reported_capable_supplier pending a primary quote. Syensqo = SYENS (cross-domain org_syensqo).

evidence.title: Zhejiang Sanhua Intelligent Controls — business / products
evidence.summary: Sanhua corporate page confirms its core thermal-management product base (microchannel heat exchangers, electronic expansion valves, control components for HVAC&R/appliances/vehicles) — the automotive thermal technology that industry coverage says it is transferring into robotics liquid cooling.
evidence.excerpt: engaged in the research and production of control components, sub-system and technological solutions applied in HVAC&R and home appliance
evidence.limitations: This primary page lists HVAC/appliance/vehicle thermal products and does NOT mention robots or humanoid robots. The Optimus/robot liquid-cooling application is reported by industry/SEO/substack coverage only. Numbers (liquid-cooling share, RMB order size, ±0.01mm) from SEO/substack are deliberately omitted as unverified.

evidence.title: Sanhua: In the AI robotics era, do cross-industry incumbents laugh last? (analyst note)
evidence.summary: Analyst note states Sanhua's current humanoid product focus is the electromechanical actuator (motor+reducer/ballscrew+sensors), NOT thermal systems — an explicit caution against treating Sanhua as a confirmed humanoid liquid-cooling supplier.
evidence.excerpt: Sanhua's humanoid focus today is electromechanical actuators rather than thermal systems, so we do not dive deeper here.
evidence.limitations: Analyst/commentary source (not primary IR). Used specifically to bound/caveat the Sanhua-as-humanoid-thermal-supplier claim, not to assert a number. Indicates Sanhua's humanoid entry is actuator-led; thermal is reported/exploratory.

evidence.title: Thermal management materials | Henkel Adhesives (Bergquist)
evidence.summary: Henkel's Bergquist thermal-management page lists the markets its TIMs serve (incl. power and industrial automation); supports Henkel as a merchant TIM supplier candidate for the humanoid thermal stack.
evidence.excerpt: These include automotive, consumer, telecom/datacom, power and industrial automation, computing, and communication, among others.
evidence.limitations: Vendor application page. Robotics is NOT named in the fetched body (industrial automation is the closest market); humanoid use is inferred, so modeled reported_capable_supplier. No number claimed. Henkel = HEN3.DE (cross-domain org_henkel).
